Inside the story

The gate that only opens with math

A butterfly leads Nia to an old iron gate, shimmering with glowing numbers. "Solve me," a voice whispers. Nia smiles…

"4 + 4 = 8!" 🎉 — and the garden swings open.

Every puzzle is a tiny win your child earns — the kind that builds real confidence with numbers.

Meet the garden

A curious girl, a magic wand & numbers with personality

Nia is bright, brave, and just like the kids reading along. And she's got company:

  • Nia — our hero, who solves the garden's math puzzles with her glowing number wand.
  • Freddy the Fox — the friendly, bespectacled guide who cheers every answer on.
  • The Number Friends — playful digits 1–9 with faces, hiding among the flowers.
  • The Number Eight Butterfly — the sparkling guide that leads Nia to the gate.
